近期难得品质上乘的解压放置游戏，不同于标准增量游戏到阶段就可以完全放置而需要一定操作量，融合了肉鸽元素，且完成度感觉还不错。 一些相较于同类型游戏更优秀的点： *开荒期不用手点即可启动 *没有各种换皮素材与无意义的换皮科技线 *多样的流派、事件、神器提供了更多的重复游玩乐趣与广度 *种类多样且深度足够的局外成长 *将与矮人题材深度绑定的黑色幽默演绎的相当不错，光是看乱七八糟的东西漫天飞舞的画面也很解压() 目前体验下来说是Steam上同类游戏中的翘楚应该不是很过分，喜欢放置类游戏的家人们务必体验一下。 ------------------ 白金后补评： 体验完整流程后感觉整体游戏设计其实在肉鸽侧重相对比较大，不是像增量游戏那样哪里亮了点哪里，有很多科技会解锁一些主动技能（虽然我整个流程基本没用过x），且发展规划会很大程度影响自身发育速度，控制输出与提升资源利用率很重要。 存在输出检测及条件检测关卡，但发育正常的话基本可以无压力通过，过了100就是无尽。 飞升这个镐子功能带来的提升与重置1-5级声望相比实在是杯水车薪，不是为了做成就的话不太建议去碰，就算要做也建议6级声望点到一定程度再飞升，但飞升前一周目的体验还是值得给出一个好评。 ------------------ 个人游玩过程的一些心得及小巧思： 在不解锁自动点击的情况下理论上是可以利用【探险家工会】在不造输出单位不推进度的情况下进行无限发育的（彻底成为挂机游戏，但需要一定声望和神器基础，而且回报周期略长）。 一般流程我会主要拉激光炮和弩炮，利用激光的宝石萃取和弩炮优先攻击巢穴的特性（巢穴血量独立于山体之外，且包含稀有产出），辅以矿工的宝石工会和铁匠的符文仪式等科技，在控制输出的同时尽可能提高发育效率，后面觉得可以推进度了开始拉烈焰领主，输出高到看不懂。 ※检测关的数值： 20：18K+4个2.5K左右的巢穴≈28K 40：280K 50：检测等级2的三色钥匙神器，集齐给等级5圣饰[ 60：4M 80：54M，疑似有火焰抗性（但烈焰领主实在太夯了所以无所谓） 100：检测8个需要的等级5神器 ※世界巨峰门票8神器来源： 4个Boss在3分钟内限时击杀获得：地精王冠、龙蛋、山脉核心、幽影烈焰鞭 1个熔炉-锻造神器概率获得：命运转盘 1个实验室-炼金术概率获得：贤者之石 1个随机掉落：阿肯宝石 1个50关检测通过获得：纳格莱尔圣饰

This game is very fun but I did refund (later bought it again) because I just don't (decided that I do) want to do everything I did in the demo again. I fully do recommend it if you enjoy idle games. You should buy it.

Not only is it a blatant rip-off of Gnorp, it's significantly worse imo. Gnorp has that great dopamine-centric number-go-up feel with lots happening on the screen; this game is shockingly slow and unexciting, and progression feels meaningless.

It's.. alright. Fun and kind of addictive initially, but there are basically no choices to make. I mean yeah, you can't really lose in incrementals, but here it feels like you can't really optimize much either. And once you get a certain artifact even the tiniest illusion of choice disappears, and you just keep clicking whatever buffs flamers as they're like 100x better than anything else. GNORP Apologue at least attempted to have different builds. Just not worth the price, wouldn't have felt as bad picking this up on sale but for the release price there are better incrementals. With some updates this could get better though.

体量大概就是7-10小时左右的小游戏。前期相当坐牢，不可避免的陷入好几轮刷声望成长的循环，这个阶段是爽不了的。声望4以后迎来质变，开始有点挂机爽游的节奏，然后在100层戛然而止。然后告诉我声望变成飞升了，从头再来接着去刷吧，我tm直接一个地铁老头看手机，除了成就收集癖找不到死磕飞升的价值。 有几个很致命的缺点，其一是升级项太多，要成长到能挂机过的程度起码前40层是得不停操作买升级的，不然伤害效率和资源增长都跟不上。其二是升级收益和支出的完全不匹配，像秘银这种产出全看脸的资源居然要参与到关键的伤害增长里，这就很生草了，屯一波秘银买个升级发现伤害增长还不如加俩人这种挫败感是极其强烈的，一圈买完发现只有烈焰领主强的离谱，其他都菜的抠脚。最后就还是节奏问题，以增量游戏的标准看单局长的过分，而以挂机的标准看又结束的太快叠不出爽感，我是两种游戏都玩的，在这个游戏里并没有找到玩增量或者放置该有的乐趣。 最近增量类别的独立游戏确实不少（不知道是不是roblox的屁孩们长大自立门户了），但质量高的真没几个，这游戏也掉到这个圈子里，理解不了增长爽点的制作人做的游戏，玩着只有疲惫。 26.5.22补充，破壁小游戏竟惊现神人开发！一个放置游戏里唯一能保证通关的兵种被一刀削了？什么煞笔开发会觉得一个放置游戏需要搞数值平衡？欧美游戏真tm没一点救了。
被挂机游戏词条吸引进来的，玩了之后只能说挂机不了一点，冲着挂机收菜来的不建议买。个人感觉玩起来还行，姑且给一个好评，但是价格偏贵了，体量只有20元以下。这游戏就差在刚刚爽起来就结束了，希望之后能更新无尽模式好好让人挂机。

这不是个纯粹挂机的游戏，因为你必须一直加点加伤害，不然40层过不去就强行转生…… 后面也是的，你不加点，都会有个BOSS卡着让你必须转生…… 我想给中评，可是没有，标签里是挂机游戏但是强行转生这点很别扭， 因为我既然选择挂机游戏，必然不会频繁去操作，可是这个游戏你不操作就不成长，不成长就必然强行转生，然后拿那稀少的声望去加点，反反复复的…… 我因为睡觉、画画、爬塔……好几次都被强行转生了，我生气，哼！
Too fast-paced and active to be an idler, and too slow-paced and passive to be a tower defense. I'm not sure what the end goal was for this game, but I think it missed the mark.

I am a 45 yo father, probably one of the oldest people playing this game. I am a single farther to my Son, who is 14 now. My son got this game for Christmas in 2021 from his uncle, so we installed it on his computer and he started playing. By the end of the week he had 24 hours on this game. This was horrible for me, as it was already hard for me to find ways to spend time with my son, as he is always out with his friends or just watching YouTube. So I decided to make a Steam account and get this game to see if I could maybe play alongside him. I loaded into the game, picked my character and started playing but I was stuck on what you where supposed to do. I asked my Son for help and he hosted a game for me to join. I loved it as it was the best time I had spent with my Son since my wife had died. This game has ever since brought me and my son closer again and now we actually spend time together outside the house together as well. This game reminded me that there's fun to be had in everything, and it has brought both me and my Son many happy memories.

飞升的收益就像： 我为了右腿上的一根腿毛长得更粗壮黑亮，我把整个右腿砍了让它重新长 I grew stronger through reincarnation and ascension. Yet this leaves me less time to collect the eight sacred artifacts. I failed because I reached the 100th floor before finishing the required artifacts via alchemy and forging. It doesn't make sense to me that becoming stronger ends up making one weaker.

挂机游戏不够挂机，挂个大半天就要手动重开转生麻烦的要死，转生个几次就累了不想玩了

1.单机游戏改平衡（不能理解为什么不提前平衡好，然后削弱强势轮椅的武器，主动舍弃爽点，玩家玩腻了自然会玩别的流派） 2.没有前期质变的转生，转生数值太抠了，每次前期用的时间都差不多，逼着你重复玩无聊的前期，同时还要思考速率平衡，最后搞个意义不明的飞升（可能想强行延长游戏寿命，但数值给的也低，一般不到20个小时一次流程结束，各种强化也试过了，反正我是玩不下去了，也就是30块的质量） 3.不能一直挂机，每20关会有一个东西来卡你，如果条件达不到就逼着你转生（更新里改了，但一个游戏刚出就这么频繁改动真的好吗，我之前被40关卡了几次转生算什么） 4.各种强化解锁条件不明，第一次解锁要一个一个试

I think this has a lot of potential but i really cant recommend it. I spent way too long on this game without having fun. Its too expensive for what it offers. Its extremely poorly balanced. Like legit, theres only 1 way to play. It gives you the illusion of builds by giving you prestige upgrades into certain dwarfs but you cant refund it so if you tried a run with Demo but now want to try Miners? Good luck, back to the grind. The UI is unintuitive and the tooltips require SO MUCH MORE INFORMATION. I dont know what a "Transmutation Ritual" is, and the game never explains it. This happens so many times. You also cant see what upgrades are available for the towers before you stumble upon it. I get the mystery but it just ends up being guesswork. Since you have "Mithrill" as a limited resource you cant gaurantee to get enough of, you kinda just haphazardly upgrade what you THINK might unlock something new and fancy but then get disappointed, run out of mithril so you have to prestige and start over just to see if you can explore something new. I fell for sunk cost fallacy where i kept believing i was close to finishing the achievements but ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ even after the ascension it was still slow as hell.

游戏是具有成长性的，前期基本挂不了机，后期挂机是指升一级需要几百万几千万金币的时候挂机放很久才能攒到所以才需要挂机，本质不算挂机游戏，顶多可以在没钱等着的时候刷会视频，其余时间都要盯着按技能或是升级设备，甚至操作的很频繁，玩的挺累的，和速速上菜似的。 还有那转生和飞升的抽象设定，前期基本会卡40关，因为没转生没有属性点加成，然后50关要集齐3把钥匙又要卡，完事了一百关要集齐8个神器还要卡，基本要玩很多个周目才能过100关，然后解锁无尽模式，更抽象的来了，飞升系统，你废了一堆时间精力点满的前五级属性点，飞升过后全部清零。逆天了 但总体来说还算个好游戏，就是标签挂的不对，一堆人冲着挂机来买的结果打开游戏和上班似的，你说恶心人吧，但它又确实有点好玩

还算有点意思的增量游戏吧，但是不到无尽挂机不了一点 新手建议前期就用矿工或者火，飞升之后可以考虑玩别的流派比如弩车，无限成长（没飞升之前开局秘银和钱不够）
不是很能解放双手，带点策略的小游戏。全成就大概30-40h，全成就小经验：1. 打完第20波或者40波，拿到声望战利品就转生，然后每个大循环用掉250声望+适当点几个6级强化就飞升；2. 起手先升探险家协会和圣坛，可以快速1级沙布祭坛，开始寻找声望；3. 相信烈焰领主吧 ！ 质量尚可，熟练科技解锁顺序后套路比较单一，100波后无尽模式可以实现真·挂机。

质量内容都很不错丰富的半挂机游戏，这游戏前期是没法挂机的，是真的需要你去运营，游戏内容就是帮矮人攻击山脉获得黄金宝石，游戏的转生系统做的很棒，像素画风下的黄金宝石闪闪发光很养眼音效也不错，总之正反馈超级多，值得一试！

1.消耗前五级至少250声望飞升，飞升后除6级以点击奖励外其他声望全清空（需要重复6次），以换取获取蚊子腿奖励的资格。 （6级奖励有飞升等级限制，飞升x次后可以升级x次） 2.100级以后的山峰甚至需要 锻造+50级前收集3把钥匙+击败boos获取对应神器，到了100级没锻到，或者错过击败boos，会强制要求转生。 3.通关100级山平均需要33.6h游戏时长 4.通关100级山平均产出180-200左右声望 5.无法长时间挂机，需要补充战力+回收资源+其他的升级 6.想要获取高收益，需要及时使用技能，调整站位 没坐过牢的可以试试。

好玩而且很爽的一个增量游戏。各个系统之间联动效果不错，成吨的宝石黄金掉下来的满足感也比较强。并且游戏元素也丰富，要挑战100关的终极山体需要搜集8个神器，包括在3分钟内打爆20、40、60、80这四波的boss，在50波前收集齐三个钥匙（还有爬塔的事，那我第四喜欢的角色在哪），然后还有锻造和地下探索的产出。 进度解锁方面也很友好，基本上每次转生都能解锁出新的东西，不会让你长时间卡在某个地方无法推进。飞升系统也是可选项，飞升了可以拿成就，可以利用重复升级提上限和加快启动速度，但不飞升也能通100关。作者也给力，改动基本都是让玩家爽的。 游戏玩法大致上可以分成两个部分 1.用各种武器攻击山体产出矿石，但同时也会引发落石和各种灾厄。 2.通过各种手段把出的矿石捡回来变成钱。 不同的武器和采集方式有不同的优势，比如炸药伤害高还群攻但是更容易引发灾厄，激光炮前期有点弱但成型之后输出奇高，弩炮能主动瞄准敌人巢穴等等。 采集上，矿工便宜量足，采集速度一般，随着科技提升采集效率会直线提高，特别是到了解锁出机械臂投掷的技能之后，采矿效率甚至超过矿车。 矿车的采集速度极快，只要开过去转回来就行，并且还可以加装顶部机枪拦截落石，中期的中坚力量。但到了后期面对巨量落石生存能力反而不如高闪避的矿工。 直升机的采集比较随缘，后期矿物特别多的时候可以达到很高的采集效率。 唤石者采集速度比较低，哪怕吃了加成也不高，但胜在稳定，不会被落石之类的打断，可以提供稳定的现金流。 （游戏时长在另一个号上，勿喷）

被骗了，最高效率的升级方式是每隔20层转生一次，这就意味着操作量高的吓人，而且烈焰领主砍了以后依然是断档最强的职业我问你砍这一刀的意义在哪里，不想让玩家爽，不爽我玩增量游戏干什么？飞升声望最多125吗，一个增量游戏增量有强上限我请问增量在哪？ 想玩无尽需要在有限的时间里集齐任务神器那我问你任务神器是到进度了天上自己掉下来的还是我可以用游戏内的钱买吗？都不是，要随机挖掘/锻造出来的，飞升次数越多输出越高输出时间越短越容易拿不到神器错过无尽模式，你看，这下悖论了，为了提高挖掘锻造效率我还必须隔几分钟回去看一眼扩充一下规模，否则错过了就只能转生，挂机游戏他挂机了吗？ 拿不到神器这局就要转生，终局强化给的数值又抠搜，可以说飞升5次以后面板就定式了，增量不增量，挂机不挂机，一想到这样的游戏卖36块我就觉得无语
前期坐牢，后期也坐牢，喜欢坐牢的一定要来品鉴一下。

Can't really recommend it. Prestige upgrades are hit or miss. Some are absolutely required while many are just a waste of points. Ascensions are second layer of prestige, anything after the first is a waste of time. Upgrades for certain units are strict downgrades, for example Cocaine for your runners. This gives them an extremely negligible bonus to gathering and movement speed as well as stun duration but none of this really matters since it guts your dodge chance. Flamelord is another, it trades out a flamer for a flamelord who gets absolutely nothing at all going for it. It loses its aoe and dots with nothing to show for it. Calamities are a major ♥♥♥♥ you to the player. Most of them cannot be mitigated in anyway. For example you have Dancing Boulders which causes a stream of boulders to go bouncing across the screen, usually at the same speed your bulldozers and runners move at meaning that even if they manage to dodge the initial boulder there's a good chance these idiots will run back under it and get hit, even more so if you give them cocaine. Or Volcanic Eruption which WILL stop your economy no matter what upgrades or setup you have. The falling meteors cannot be shot down with your antirock turrets as they cannot produce enough dps to break them. Even a stack of railguns cannot manage these. Especially with the density. Spelunkers guild is a massive noob trap. You have to sink copious amounts of dwarves and resources into this building just to get it started and a majority of the time your dwarves are either going to come back empty handed, get injured in some manner, or just straight up die. And on the incredibly rare occassions they actually prove their worth you get maybe 2000 gold or a vein of mithril if you're lucky. Meadhalls are also a waste of time, the kegs only ever fall in the center of the map making the gold amber keg worthless and the oxlung only mostly worthless. Duke Cannons are not strong enough for the detriment they are to your own runners with the cannonballs falling on your runners. Unless you get lucky and get the Gravel Marble which removes hitting your own units. This should've been an upgrade for PP not a random chance upgrade you HAVE to reacquire every run unless you sacrifice a better relic to keep this one (which still requires you to get it in the first place) TLDR: a lot of tedium wrapped up in even more ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥. Go play the demo on itch, but at the current point in its development I cannot recommend it over free games like Idle Pins or Reactor Incremental 1.

[h1] 所见即所得的增量小品 [/h1] [h3] 山的后面……还是山 [/h3] 体感很怪的一款游戏，能看出缝了很多同类游戏的元素进去，但本质取其精华留其糟粕。虽然商店界面打了挂机和增量的标，但游戏里不仅没有离线收益和自动化，正常挂机收益低得惊人的同时转生的收益也不尽人意。简单来说就是《糯米团子历代记》建造玩法和《Clicker Heroes》闯关模式的缝合，但同时也把操作量大和游戏流程短的缺陷都缝进去了，还染上了时间墙。 本作有剧情内容的流程只有100关，100关之后是无尽的打小龙虾，到了后期还会出现明显的卡顿。虽然也有转生重置的机制，但不同于大多数同类游戏对于转生资源的设计，本作转生所获取的资源并不会有指数级的增长，也不会根据获取量来提升获取难度，这就意味着每次转生时获取的资源来源基本是一致的。游戏中稳定获取转生资源的方法在前中期只有过关，每1~3关随机给一点，而在敌人数值和所需金币都是以倍数增长的情况下，玩家伤害很容易就触到软上限，推进速度明显变慢。 这种收益有一定线性区间但难度却指数提升的设计本身就是鼓励速转玩法的，但本作的内容量却支撑不起这种玩法。点满所有强化总共只需要481点资源，并且其中一半都只是小幅数值提升或者一两个免费单位，只会让开局变得舒服一点点。 而游戏内虽然也有多（二）级转生的内容设计，但这个部分的数值给的相当幽默，很难想象一个增量游戏的终局内容会是增加0.25%伤害/级这样的内容。并且因为数值给的太低，在本身会清空第一级转生所有强化的情况下却不能快速重点，如果不手操速转的话，我即使是第七次也仍要挂十几小时后才能点满。这就导致了如果以通关为目的的话，这部分内容是完全的副作用，纯粹拖时长的玩法。 本作的挂机玩法在累计花费50点转生资源后解锁探险家行会才正式开始，行会里的每个单位可以定期带来涵盖游戏中所有资源的全面收益。又因为游戏的通关条件是在规定时间（3分钟）内打败每隔20关出现的所有Boss。这就导致了最舒服的玩法其实是[spoiler] 在点出保留自选神器（180）后选择探险家不会死亡的神器，然后转生后全部金币梭哈探险家行会并不买任何攻击性单位，再美美睡一觉。第二天起来就资源自由了，然后花几分钟就能打穿100关 [/spoiler]。 在100关后就会进入无尽模式，但因为本作玩家的伤害是由单局中一个个线性加法的乘区叠加而来的，而在这些乘区里，5%/级就已经算稀有的高数值了，那些无上限的强化基本都被锁死在0.0025%到0.2%的极低区间内。在面对山血量稳定倍增（1.+）的情况下，基本属于弃之可惜的鸡肋。无论何时，都有一座你跨不过的山在后面等着你。而如果选择二级转生的话，则是重复之前的过程吃蚊子腿的提升，这时候基本就已经进化成电子盆栽了。 总之是一款初看很惊艳的作品，一上来直接明牌全部内容糊脸带来了巨大的新鲜感，导致我一直以为它还在藏东西，直到我把能点满的全部点满并挂到了300关，才发现并没有藏，真的只有这么多。游戏体验基本处于前中期半牢而后期空虚[spoiler] 还很卡 [/spoiler]的状态，这个游戏内容量只能说配不上这个价格（指20%off），如果后续没有实质内容更新的话，推荐半价左右入手。

End game is awful. It's locked behind an RNG gate, and each "roll" at that RNG requires a 5+ hour run to get to it. If you miss, you get to try again -- or ascend to start over and get one step closer to a skill that eliminates that RNG. You have to ascend 5 times to get that skill, and each ascension takes at least two long runs. If you want those ascensions to go faster, you actually have to do ~4 long runs to get enough skills to unlock the next ascension and to buff up the skills that will make your next run go quicker (the ascension buff skills don't count toward unlocking the ascension -- you have to have enough *other* skills before you're even allowed to ascend) Oh, and you can't really just leave the game playing itself. The game scales so quickly that you'll have to spend a few minutes every hour upgrading things. Recommendation: don't get this game. The sunk cost fallacy is real. I'm forcing myself to quit after 90 hours because the loop just isn't fun. If you get lucky and beat the RNG gate early, the game could be awesome. But failing it too many times is just irritating and getting back to that point to try again is irritating and using the game's mechanics to bypass the RNG gate is irritating.

It's not exactly an idler. It's not quite a clicker. But it borrows from both of those genres. All I know is, I can't put it down. Most idlers/clickers have a slow-to-start power curve that snowballs with a few upgrades and then offers diminishing returns until the next tier (a log-lin plot, for the math nerds.) That's definitely present here, but there are a couple of balancing factors that keep it interesting. First, there's a shared resource between all buildings (dwarves,) which has its own gold cost to produce. Second, just dealing damage doesn't get you the gold. You have to invest in a set of non-damage-dealing structures to keep it flowing, as well as ways to protect your gold collectors from falling rocks launched by the damage you're doing. This makes for a balancing act with your upgrades, where just idling for a bit and then dumping ten minutes' worth of gold into one upgrade isn't a good idea. You'll either choke off your own gold supply with the backlash from the resulting damage, or end up clearing the field faster than you can generate drops. Even when you're doing something else while playing, like watching a video or cleaning, just trying to keep those three factors in balance will keep you checking in every minute or so. More often than not, I've found myself dropping whatever I was trying to multitask with just to watch the bullet heaven numbers climb, because I knew what upgrade I wanted next and I didn't want to miss it when I had the resources. On top of that, there's a "prestige" system that resets your run in exchange for persistent upgrades. You're probably familiar with that sort of thing, but once again Dwarf Eats Mountain keeps it interesting. Most of the upgrades are straight percentage bonuses or resource saves that stretch your run further into the late game before you hit the top-end-of-the-curve slowdown. But some upgrades change the power balance between certain structures, and completely change the way you play in the early and mid game. This means instead of two runs being differentiated by nothing but RNG, you get to make real choices about how you want to play differently next time, and discover the results of that. Lastly, big props to the dev for well-thought-out fine-tuning and tweaking just before (with a demo, rather than early access) and after release. Features which were clearly part of the original concept, like forced resets after certain DPM-check levels, were dropped when they just didn't mesh with the way players actually played and instead the reason to reset is now balanced-tuned around the end of the curve. Bottom line, if you played Cookie Clicker even once and enjoyed it, you'll find Dwarf Eats Mountain to be fun and engaging for many, many hours.
